title: import_sieve's module_name reads a '/' path as a dotted module on every box
intention: module_name names the same dotted module for the same file on every box.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienyoga9i (Windows) at main: module_name('cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py') answered 'cairn/tools/base/diagnostic', because it split on os.sep and os.sep is a backslash there; its docstring and every caller hand it '/' paths. build_inspector's every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin then named no module and read DiagnosticBase itself as 'no route': test_every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py red 4 teeth on Windows, sealed green on Linux. With the fix it is green on Windows.
how: D1: module_name splits on '/' after replacing os.sep with '/', so a '/' path and a native path both name their dotted module on every box. D2: new proof test_module_name_reads_a_slash_path_on_every_box.py pins the module's os.sep to a backslash, so its teeth red the unfixed split on Linux too.

clauses.claim: under a backslash os.sep, a '/' path and a '/' package __init__ name their dotted module
under a backslash os.sep, a native backslash path still names its dotted module
